verdict.rationale:
SES documentation mentions that access to email sending can be controlled via AWS IAM, which supports creating least-privilege, scoped policies/credentials — a mechanism that could be used to issue restricted API access to an agent. However, there is no SES-specific guidance, example policies, or agent-oriented tooling (e.g., temporary STS credentials, per-agent scoping) documented beyond this single generic statement.

missing for 10: SES-specific least-privilege IAM policy examples, agent-specific credential issuance guidance, temporary/short-lived credential support (STS) documentation, independent verification of scoped-credential usage in agentic workflows.
